judge.rationale: Agreement is limited: A and B share RB–E2F/CDK4/6 and several cycling markers, C overlaps with them through RB/E2F, FOXM1, and CDKN1B and with D through CDKN1A/CDKN1B-mediated arrest, but the ER/MYC, TGF-β/SMAD/CAF, and HIF1A mechanisms use largely distinct contributors, so more than half of the complete molecular content differs and the shared-minority ceiling applies.
